words.display: SELECT name AS display_name FROM users AS u;
words.input: SELECT name AS display_name FROM users AS u;
words.annotation: AS：別名を付ける

words.display: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id IN (1, 2, 3);
words.input: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id IN (1, 2, 3);
words.annotation: IN：候補に含まれるか

words.display: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id NOT IN (1, 2);
words.input: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id NOT IN (1, 2);
words.annotation: NOT IN：候補に含まれないか（候補にNULLを含むと意図しない結果になり得る。NOT EXISTSも検討）

words.display: SELECT * FROM users WHERE age BETWEEN 20 AND 29;
words.input: SELECT * FROM users WHERE age BETWEEN 20 AND 29;
words.annotation: BETWEEN：両端を含む範囲（日時では>=と<の半開区間が便利）

words.display: SELECT * FROM users WHERE age IS DISTINCT FROM 20;
words.input: SELECT * FROM users WHERE age IS DISTINCT FROM 20;
words.annotation: IS DISTINCT FROM：NULLを含めた不等比較（NULLも比較可能な値として扱う）

words.display: SELECT * FROM users WHERE name LIKE 'Po%';
words.input: SELECT * FROM users WHERE name LIKE 'Po%';
words.annotation: LIKE：パターン一致（%は任意長、_は任意1文字）

words.display: SELECT * FROM users WHERE name ILIKE 'po%';
words.input: SELECT * FROM users WHERE name ILIKE 'po%';
words.annotation: ILIKE：大文字小文字を区別しない一致（大文字小文字の扱いはロケール等に依存）

words.display: SELECT * FROM users WHERE name ~* '^po';
words.input: SELECT * FROM users WHERE name ~* '^po';
words.annotation: ~ / ~*：正規表現一致（~*は大文字小文字を区別しない）

words.display: SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY age ASC NULLS LAST;
words.input: SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY age ASC NULLS LAST;
words.annotation: NULLS FIRST / LAST：NULLの並び位置

words.display: SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 20 OFFSET 40;
words.input: SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 20 OFFSET 40;
words.annotation: LIMIT / OFFSET：取得件数・開始位置（一意に並ぶORDER BYを指定。大きなOFFSETは負荷になり得る）

words.display: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT department_id) FROM users;
words.input: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT department_id) FROM users;
words.annotation: COUNT(DISTINCT 列)：非NULLの異なる値の数

words.display: SELECT SUM(amount), AVG(amount) FROM orders;
words.input: SELECT SUM(amount), AVG(amount) FROM orders;
words.annotation: SUM / AVG：合計・平均（対象なしの場合は通常NULL）

words.display: SELECT ARRAY_AGG(id ORDER BY id) FROM users;
words.input: SELECT ARRAY_AGG(id ORDER BY id) FROM users;
words.annotation: ARRAY_AGG：配列へ集約

words.display: SELECT JSONB_AGG(name ORDER BY id) FROM users;
words.input: SELECT JSONB_AGG(name ORDER BY id) FROM users;
words.annotation: JSONB_AGG：JSON配列へ集約

words.display: SELECT id FROM users EXCEPT SELECT user_id FROM orders;
words.input: SELECT id FROM users EXCEPT SELECT user_id FROM orders;
words.annotation: INTERSECT / EXCEPT：共通部分・差集合（列数と型に互換性が必要）

words.display: INSERT INTO users (name) VALUES ('A'), ('B');
words.input: INSERT INTO users (name) VALUES ('A'), ('B');
words.annotation: 複数行INSERT：複数行を追加

words.display: INSERT INTO counters DEFAULT VALUES RETURNING id;
words.input: INSERT INTO counters DEFAULT VALUES RETURNING id;
words.annotation: DEFAULT VALUES：既定値で追加（IDENTITYの例で作成するcounters表向け。全必須列に既定値がある表で使用）

words.display: DELETE FROM users WHERE id = 1 RETURNING id;
words.input: DELETE FROM users WHERE id = 1 RETURNING id;
words.annotation: DELETE / WHERE：行を削除（WHEREなしは全行削除。外部キー制約で拒否される場合がある）

words.input: CREATE TABLE items (id bigint PRIMARY KEY);
words.annotation: PRIMARY KEY：主キー（一意かつNOT NULL）

words.display: ALTER TABLE users ALTER COLUMN email SET NOT NULL;
words.input: ALTER TABLE users ALTER COLUMN email SET NOT NULL;
words.annotation: NOT NULL：NULL禁止（既存NULLがあると失敗）

words.display: ALTER TABLE users ALTER COLUMN active SET DEFAULT true;
words.input: ALTER TABLE users ALTER COLUMN active SET DEFAULT true;
words.annotation: DEFAULT：既定値（既存行の値は変更しない）

words.display: ALTER TABLE users DROP CONSTRAINT users_name_unique;
words.input: ALTER TABLE users DROP CONSTRAINT users_name_unique;
words.annotation: DROP CONSTRAINT：制約を削除（制約が存在する場合）

words.display: SELECT 42::integer, 10000000000::bigint;
words.input: SELECT 42::integer, 10000000000::bigint;
words.annotation: integer / bigint：整数

words.display: SELECT 'hello'::text, 'abc'::varchar(10);
words.input: SELECT 'hello'::text, 'abc'::varchar(10);
words.annotation: text / varchar(n)：文字列（varchar(n)は長さ制限）

words.display: SELECT TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 12:00:00+09';
words.input: SELECT TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 12:00:00+09';
words.annotation: timestamptz：時点を扱う日時（表示はセッションTimeZoneに依存。元の地域名は保持しない）

words.display: SELECT '{"name":"Pomo"}'::jsonb;
words.input: SELECT '{"name":"Pomo"}'::jsonb;
words.annotation: json / jsonb：JSON（jsonbはインデックス対応。キー順・重複キーの保持等がjsonと異なる）

words.display: SELECT ARRAY['go', 'sql']::text[];
words.input: SELECT ARRAY['go', 'sql']::text[];
words.annotation: 型[] / ARRAY：配列（PostgreSQLの配列添字は通常1から）

words.display: SELECT COALESCE(email, '未登録') FROM users;
words.input: SELECT COALESCE(email, '未登録') FROM users;
words.annotation: COALESCE：最初の非NULL値

words.display: SELECT amount / NULLIF(0, 0) FROM orders;
words.input: SELECT amount / NULLIF(0, 0) FROM orders;
words.annotation: NULLIF：等しいならNULL（ゼロ除算回避等）

words.display: SELECT CAST('123' AS integer), '123'::integer;
words.input: SELECT CAST('123' AS integer), '123'::integer;
words.annotation: CAST / ::：型変換（変換不可はエラー）

words.display: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) FROM users;
words.input: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) FROM users;
words.annotation: EXTRACT：日時の要素を取得

words.display: SELECT NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo';
words.input: SELECT NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo';
words.annotation: AT TIME ZONE：タイムゾーンの解釈・変換（入力型により戻り値型・意味が異なる）

words.display: SELECT profile #>> '{address,city}' FROM users;
words.input: SELECT profile #>> '{address,city}' FROM users;
words.annotation: #> / #>>：JSONの深いパス

words.display: SELECT * FROM users WHERE profile ? 'name';
words.input: SELECT * FROM users WHERE profile ? 'name';
words.annotation: ?：JSONBのキー等の存在（ドライバーによってプレースホルダー記号との扱いに注意）

words.display: SELECT * FROM users WHERE 'sql' = ANY(tags);
words.input: SELECT * FROM users WHERE 'sql' = ANY(tags);
words.annotation: ANY：配列要素との比較

words.display: SELECT id, unnest(tags) AS tag FROM users;
words.input: SELECT id, unnest(tags) AS tag FROM users;
words.annotation: unnest：配列を行へ展開

words.input: BEGIN READ ONLY; SELECT * FROM users; COMMIT;
words.annotation: READ ONLY：読み取り専用トランザクション

words.display: EXPLAIN SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = 1;
words.input: EXPLAIN SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = 1;
words.annotation: EXPLAIN：実行計画を表示（通常は対象SQLを実行しない）
